findings.desc: packages/main/src/tasks/lattice-baseline-smoke.ts claims stale-artifact coverage but never seeds a stale final-report or stale lower-layer suite report. The only negative suite case at lines 443-469 covers malformed JSON, mixed-schema, and authority-overclaim; the claim cases at lines 471-513 cover missing lower layers and sequential unlock only. CHK-001/002/003/005/006 verificationEvidence says smoke verified stale rejection, but this required fail-closed path is untested and the recorded evidence overstates coverage.

packages/main/src/core/lattice-baseline.ts:1171-1232 and 1277-1279 promote purely local baseline_run stub artifacts into engineering suiteStatus=PASS/authorization=authorized as soon as a development suite file exists. Repro: seed a PASS development baseline-suite-report.json, run baseline_run for each ENG-* id, then run node packages/main/dist/cli.js baseline_suite_report --layer=engineering --format=json; it returns PASS/authorized with no real engineering proof. That violates the documented boundary that Parallel Development is implementation-only and claim/proof unlock stays sequential (Lattice-Parallel-Development-Capability.md:28-31, 82-84), and Engineering suite PASS requires real runs plus maturity/rate checks (Lattice-Engineering-baseline.md:421-469), not local harness presence.
